messages.subject: UAE / Saudi Arabia Executive Profile | Infrastructure, Energy Transition, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Ashurst,

I am introducing my profile for retained and confidential senior leadership mandates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. A2 Talent's retained executive-search focus across infrastructure, renewable energy, water, transport and government facilities, together with your coverage of Dubai and Riyadh, makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory within a major mining, infrastructure and energy-transition environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track appointments. My strongest fit is where infrastructure delivery, energy transition, government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships, natural resources and country operations intersect.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My GCC-focused executive CV is attached for consideration across suitable A2 Talent mandates in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
